summary: HCP-to-patient linking, directory improvements, and a range of reliability fixes across enrollment, tasks, and team management.

updates.title: HCP Patient Linking
updates.body: Teams can now manually associate an HCP to a patient directly from the Patient Profile. Teams can also change the primary HCP for a patient at any time. If no direct link exists, the system automatically falls back to the Primary HCP when resolving patient status.

updates.title: HCP & HCO Directory Search
updates.body: The HCP list is now searchable by HCP ID; HCO and Infusion Site IDs appear alongside names in dropdowns; and a new Tasks tab is available on both HCP and HCO directory pages.

updates.title: Timezone-Aware Date & Time
updates.body: Date and time fields across the app now reflect the user's selected timezone, including inquiry comment timestamps.

updates.title: Enrollment ID Link
updates.body: Fixed the Enrollment ID not displaying as a hyperlink in the Edit Task form; it now correctly navigates to the associated enrollment form.

updates.title: Team Management
updates.body: "Select All" option has been added to the Territory multi-select on the Create Team form.

updates.title: Inquiry Assignment
updates.body: Fixed a dropdown that incorrectly allowed selection of SP users and teams without the required referral source access.

updates.title: HCP Territory Display
updates.body: Fixed territory not appearing after updating an HCP profile using the same zip code.

updates.title: Infusion Site Phone Number
updates.body: Fixed phone number disappearing from the Infusion Site table after creation or editing; removal of a phone number now also persists after save.

updates.title: FRM Role Name
updates.body: Corrected the display name for the FRM role type.

updates.title: HCP & HCO Directory Matching
updates.body: HCP and Infusion Site creation now returns exact matches by name or ID.

updates.title: Insurance Plan Editing
updates.body: Fixed a server error that occurred when editing an Insurance Plan by Payer Type and Plan Type.

updates.title: Team-Level Support Ticket Isolation
updates.body: Tenant users now only see and interact with support tickets belonging to their own team(s), preventing unintended cross-team data exposure in the support portal.
